component.name: Crop Picture
component.summary: Crop custom-size images for web assets

description.p: Crop Picture is a native GNOME desktop utility designed to crop custom-size rectangular and square images from common web formats including JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, and TIFF.
First official release supporting customizable rectangular/square crop sizes, zoom framing adjustments, and multi-architecture Debian packages.
